name: neurodivergent-task-manager
description: A personal task system on your own todo list, for the places that get in the way: starting things, keeping multi-day work moving, noticing what has gone stale, not forgetting things, and buying on a good price instead of on impulse. Plans your days and weeks, reminds you in a style you choose, and watches prices so you can wait for a good one without forgetting. Run /neurodivergent-task-manager:configure once; your settings and style live in a small plugin of your own.
